people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: Yahweh’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
translations.bsb: And the hand of the LORD came upon Elijah, and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.
translations.kjv: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
translations.asv: and the hand of Jehovah was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
